{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Fitted knit top, long sleeve, hip length, red (#B22234), soft merino-blend knit
High-waisted straight-leg jeans, full ankle length, dark indigo (#1F2A44), stretch cotton denim
Ankle boots, low block heel, round toe, cognac brown (#8B5A2B), smooth leather
Trench coat, single-breasted, knee length, camel (#C19A6B), cotton gabardine
Crossbody bag, small structured, cognac brown (#8B5A2B), smooth leather
Soft scarf, light drape, cream (#F2E8D5), wool-cashmere blend
Small gold hoop earrings (#D4AF37), polished metal

This outfit works because the red knit gives her the red she asked for and puts it right at the center of the look, which is lovely for a first date. Dark jeans and leather ankle boots keep it relaxed and neat, fitting an easy walk through the park and a coffee afterward. The trench and cream scarf add warmth for an autumn day without feeling heavy, and the camel, cream and cognac tones sit softly beside the red. Everything is comfortable to walk in, so she can stay at ease and focus on the conversation."}
